target.statement: fastText with h=10 and bigram features achieves 92.5% test accuracy on AG News (Table 1, row 'fastText, h = 10, bigram', column AG).
target.dataset: AG News (Zhang et al. 2015 sentiment analysis benchmark)

compute.basis: fastText trains on AG News in about 1 second per run according to Table 2, and the full Table 1 protocol is a small 5-epoch CPU training with a 4-value learning-rate search on public 120k-example data.
